description: This file contains unit tests for the harvester_rbus_api module, utilizing Google Test and Google Mock frameworks. It tests functions related to RBUS handle management, initialization, uninitialization, value retrieval, and datastore interactions, specifically within a testing fixture context.

classes.name: HarvesterTestFixture
classes.description: A test fixture providing common setup for tests related to harvester rbus API, with mock objects for rbus and debug components.

methods.name: TestGetRbusHandle
methods.description: Verifies that get_rbus_handle correctly returns the expected handle.

methods.name: TestRbusInitializedCheck_Initialized
methods.description: Checks that rbusInitializedCheck returns true when rbus_handle is initialized.

methods.name: TestRbusInitializedCheck_Uninitialized
methods.description: Checks that rbusInitializedCheck returns false when rbus_handle is NULL.

methods.name: HarvesterRbusInit_Success
methods.description: Tests successful initialization of rbus connection via harvesterRbusInit.

methods.name: HarvesterRbusInit_Failure
methods.description: Tests failure scenario during rbus open in harvesterRbusInit.

methods.name: HarvesterRbusUninit
methods.description: Verifies that harvesterRbus_Uninit calls rbus_close properly.

methods.name: TestRbusGetBoolValue_NotInitialized
methods.description: Ensures rbus_getBoolValue returns error when rbus_handle is not initialized.

methods.name: TestRbusGetBoolValue_RbusGetFails
methods.description: Tests handling of failure from rbus_get when retrieving boolean value.

methods.name: TestRbusGetBoolValue_Success
methods.description: Verifies successful retrieval of boolean value via rbus_getBoolValue.

methods.name: RbusGetStringValue_NotInitialized
methods.description: Checks error return when rbus_handle is NULL during string retrieval.

methods.name: RbusGetStringValue_RbusGetFails
methods.description: Tests failure handling during rbus_get for string values.

methods.name: RbusGetStringValue_Success
methods.description: Verifies successful string retrieval using rbus_getStringValue.

methods.name: RbusGetUInt32Value_NotInitialized
methods.description: Checks error return if rbus_handle is NULL when retrieving uint32 values.

methods.name: RbusGetUInt32Value_RbusGetFails
methods.description: Tests handling of rbus_get failure for uint32 retrieval.

methods.name: RbusGetUInt32Value_Success
methods.description: Verifies successful retrieval of a uint32 value.

methods.name: RbusGetValueFromPsmDB_NotInitialized
methods.description: Checks error case when rbus_handle is NULL during PSM database value fetch.

methods.name: RbusGetValueFromPsmDB_InvokeFailure
methods.description: Tests failure of invoking the RBUS method for fetching PSM record value.

methods.name: RbusGetValueFromPsmDB_Success
methods.description: Verifies successful fetching of a value from PSM database via RBUS.

methods.name: RegHarvesterDataModel_Success
methods.description: Tests successful registration of data elements with RBUS for the harvester data model.
